description: Business questions on the owner's own data: aggregates, KPIs, bridges and lists (task types 2 and 4).

finance.reconcile.description: One aggregate over a period: second path, control total, coverage, transfers, magnitude.

finance.kpi.description: Each KPI recomputed with coverage checks and a sanity bound against the prior period.

finance.bridge.description: Price, volume and new/lost-item effects must add up to the total change.

finance.list.description: A delivered list's row count and sum equal the filtered aggregate; every row has an ID and date.
